scores.evidence: metrics.json shows no hard failures: overflowX false, 0 console errors, 0 mermaid errors, 0 unknown blocks, 0 broken images, and no text-only screens. The rules-diagram flowchart (TD) has readable Japanese labels at 390 px (.artifacts/preview/vibe-coding/cc-02-permissions/pages/mobile-jp-09.png). On mobile, every code chip in the question options stays whole inside its option card (mobile-jp-13.png, mobile-jp-25.png).

Each segment is short and broken up by definition tables, a diagram, steps, code and a check at most two to three screens apart. The lesson is still long at 29 mobile screens, though, and the modes-table bullet list plus modes-switch fill about two dense screens (mobile-jp-03.png, mobile-jp-04.png).

Text is all Japanese with English terms in parentheses on first use, contrast is good, and nothing in the lesson content sits under the top or bottom bars. On mobile, headings wrap at natural phrase breaks, for example '権限モードで、確認なしに / 進める範囲を選ぶ' (mobile-jp-03.png).

niceToHave: rules-prompt / rewind-prompt: the prompt text shows raw Markdown backticks, and in rules-prompt the fill-in chip sits inside them (`[読ませないファイル]`). On mobile the filename `rewind-copy.md` breaks as '`rewind-' / 'copy.md`' (.artifacts/preview/vibe-coding/cc-02-permissions/pages/mobile-jp-20.png, mobile-jp-21.png). Consider dropping the backticks around {{読ませないファイル}}, or quoting names with 「」 so the prompt reads cleanly before it is copied.

rules-order: '調べる順番は下の図のとおりです。' is followed by a second paragraph before the figure appears (mobile-jp-08.png, desktop-jp-05.png). Moving the CLAUDE.md sentence below rules-diagram, or splitting it into its own block, would put the figure right after its reference.
reader: desktop JP charsPerLine median is 41 (max 54) against the 30–40 target at a 680 px measure. This comes from the reader's column width, not the lesson.

reader: the end banner says this is the course's last lesson, because drafts are not in course.json. The mobile full-length PNG is truncated at 16000 px, and failed /api/ requests were ignored as environment noise.
summary: The lesson renders cleanly at 390 px and on desktop: no hard failures, a readable vertical flowchart, code blocks that fit, and option cards that keep their code chips whole. No personal data was seen on any screen. Remaining polish: the raw backticks in the two prompt blocks, and the figure reference in rules-order that is separated from its diagram.
